title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - CollectionPoint
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/CollectionPoint. Point where waste is collected by refuse collection vehicle (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.2.3.19). Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.2.1.1).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CollectionPoint'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the collection point, expressed as a GeoJSON Point.

hasCollectionDay.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/hasCollectionDay'. A collection point can be assigned one or more collection days. Modelled as a closed enumerated string array since time:DayOfWeek is a fixed external 7-value vocabulary (W3C Time ontology), unlike this ontology's own open 'Kind' vocabularies.
